verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.discord.com that indexes the developer docs. Individual pages are served as Markdown (.md) and each points agents back to the llms.txt index, and many cited doc pages are themselves .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: any evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on agent-oriented doc usage, plus independent corroboration beyond the probe.
